_doc: Inventory of the RATIFIED dossier format (16 Jul 2026 sample, re-ratified 9 Aug 2026). Every class here was approved by the decider and exists in the published CSS. The format gate fails when the renderer stops emitting a REQUIRED class - that is how 41 of 53 disappeared with no red test between July and August 2026.

prosa._doc: Perfil medido no exemplar ratificado. Banda = tolerância; fora dela o gate reclama.

banda._calibragem: Medido no exemplar ratificado, com folga. Regra: se o gate reprova o artefato RATIFICADO, o gate esta errado, nao o artefato.
banda._unidade_sem_tipo: Uma unidade que nao casa com nenhum tipo usa o teto de item. Antes a chave nao existia e o .get() devolvia 1.000.000: teto infinito silencioso.

prosa._nota_teto_de_secao: Teto por SECAO foi rejeitado duas vezes na medicao: a secao do conselho cresce com o numero de lentes, e a 6.4 tem piso de 400 caracteres POR sugestao no contrato — capar a secao contradizia um piso existente. O teto vive na UNIDADE: conselheiro, fork, sugestao.

_contract_version_doc: Dossiers declaring 'contract: 2' in the header are held to this inventory. A dossier without the marker is contract 1 (pre-2026-08-09) and the format gate skips it: rewriting a delivered dossier would destroy the provenance of what was decided at the time.

conditional._doc: Required only when the trigger is present in the markdown. A CONTESTED fork carries bull/bear/camp; a CONDITIONAL fork omits them BY CONTRACT (fabricating a bear where the board converged is rigor theater), so demanding them unconditionally guarantees a false red on a legitimate dossier.

not_built._doc: Declared, NOT built. Listing these as `required` would have made the gate green over a promise the renderer does not keep — the failure this whole file exists to stop.
not_built.per_item_groundedness: The contract renders evidence-anchored vs unverified as a solid vs dashed border PER ITEM. The renderer applies neither; it only printed a legend explaining the convention. The legend was removed rather than left decorating an unimplemented feature. Build trigger: cards carrying a groundedness tag reach the renderer.

chrome._doc: Page furniture the renderer always emits: checked against the WHOLE document. Deleting the sticky nav is a real regression, but chrome must never vouch for CONTENT — that is why the two scopes are separate.

_scopes: chrome -> whole document · required/conditional -> CONTENT region only (header and title block stripped). Counting everything made 13 classes unfalsifiable: they were green on a document with one sentence and zero components.
